title: Travel time: Alewife -> JFK/UMass
content: From Alewife to JFK/UMass on the Red Line, typical off-peak travel time is 32 minutes with a standard deviation of about 4 minutes. During peak hours (7-9 AM and 5-7 PM), the median is 35 minutes with standard deviation 6 minutes due to crowding and signal congestion at Park Street and Downtown Crossing.

title: Travel time: Harvard -> JFK/UMass
content: From Harvard to JFK/UMass on the Red Line, typical off-peak travel time is 22 minutes (std 3 min). At peak hours, median is 26 minutes (std 5 min).

title: Travel time: South Station -> JFK/UMass
content: South Station to JFK/UMass on the Red Line takes about 7 minutes off-peak (std 2 min). At peak, about 9 minutes (std 3 min).

title: Travel time: Kenmore -> Park Street
content: Kenmore to Park Street via Green Line subway typically takes about 11 minutes off-peak (std 3 min). At peak, about 14 minutes (std 5 min) due to surface street delays before Kenmore.

title: Travel time: Park Street -> UMass Boston Campus Center
content: From Park Street to UMass Boston Campus Center, the typical journey is: Red Line (Park -> JFK/UMass, about 9 minutes off-peak / 11 minutes peak) plus UMass shuttle (JFK/UMass -> Campus Center, about 7-10 minutes including wait). Total typical end-to-end is 22 minutes off-peak (std 5 min) and 27 minutes peak (std 7 min).

title: Travel time: North Station -> JFK/UMass
content: North Station to JFK/UMass via Orange Line transferring at Downtown Crossing takes about 18 minutes off-peak (std 4 min) including transfer time. At peak, median is 22 minutes (std 6 min).

title: Travel time: Logan Airport -> South Station
content: Logan Airport to South Station via SL1 bus rapid transit takes about 22 minutes off-peak (std 6 min) and 30 minutes peak (std 9 min) due to airport traffic.

title: Travel time: Quincy Center -> JFK/UMass
content: Quincy Center to JFK/UMass on the Red Line Braintree branch takes about 14 minutes off-peak (std 3 min). At peak, about 17 minutes (std 4 min).
